project.name: xander-mybatis-support
project.description:
MyBatis / MyBatis-Plus support (V9 §20). Only DB services depend on this; it is the reason the old "one common.jar for everything" had to be split, because carrying this module is what a WebFlux Gateway must not do.
Contents: - MybatisPlusConfig -- the pagination interceptor bean. - PageData -- the unified pagination response body.
Why PageData is here and not in xander-model: V9 §19 lists it as "purely shared" and V9 §20 puts it in xander-model while also requiring that module to have "no MyBatis". Both cannot hold: PageData's entire content is an adapter over com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.metadata.IPage. The "no MyBatis" rule wins, so it lives here, with the technology it actually depends on.
V9 §20 also mentions "公共 TypeHandler". There are none in this codebase -- the grep for TypeHandler over the whole application returns nothing -- so nothing was moved for it. If one is ever added it belongs in this module.
